descriptions.tei: Interoperable TEI representation of the edition and stand-off research layer; prototype validation status is documented in VALIDATION_REPORT.md.
descriptions.persons: Reusable person authority file derived from the master spreadsheet.
descriptions.index: UI-oriented index generated from TEI/spreadsheet identifiers.
descriptions.relations: Fast graph of T, R, S, PS and person links.
descriptions.semanticSource: Loss-preserving run-level extraction used by the interface to reproduce Word encoding and visual/editorial distinctions.
descriptions.odd: Project TEI customization and encoding policy.
descriptions.interface: Full V10.2 research interface with the V10.1 interactive knowledge map, restored graphical spreadsheet topology, and a new conceptual overview of the edition-encoding layer.
descriptions.runtimeBundle: Generated offline fallback. When served over HTTP, the interface first reads the separate JSON files directly; this bundle keeps the same interface usable as a local standalone prototype.
